settings.heading: Settings
settings.restoreLabel: Restore last tool and window position on launch
settings.showPinnedAriaLabel: Show pinned tools in the sidebar
settings.showRecentAriaLabel: Show recent tools in the sidebar
settings.dataDescription: Umbra saves your preferences and recent activity on this device, including layout, theme, and recently used tools.
settings.privacyNetwork: The only network call Umbra makes is an automatic check for updates. Nothing installs without your confirmation, and there's no telemetry.
settings.privacyClipboard: Umbra reads your clipboard locally to suggest a matching tool. Nothing leaves your device.

base64.description: Encode and decode text or files to and from Base64.
base64.heading: Base64
base64.dropHintEncode: Drop a file anywhere in the window to Base64-encode it.
base64.dropHintDecode: Drop a file whose contents are Base64 text to decode it.
base64.fileNotBase64Text: That file isn't Base64 text, so there's nothing to decode. A binary file can only be encoded — switch to Encode.

uuid.description: Generate UUID v4 or v7 identifiers, single or in bulk.
uuid.heading: UUID
uuid.countOutOfRange: Enter a whole number between 0 and {max}.
uuid.versionHelpTrigger: What is the difference between v4 and v7?
uuid.versionHelpV4: Random. Use when you just need a unique identifier.
uuid.versionHelpV7: Time-ordered: sorts by creation time, which makes a better database key.

hash.description: Compute SHA-2, SHA-3, MD5 and SHA-1 digests of text or a dropped file.
hash.heading: Hash
hash.dropHint: Drop a file anywhere in the window to hash it.
hash.weakHelpTrigger: Why are MD5 and SHA-1 flagged?
hash.weakHelpBody: MD5 and SHA-1 are broken for security use — an attacker can construct two different inputs with the same digest. They stay fine for non-adversarial checksums and deduplication, but not for signatures, tamper detection, or certificates.
hash.noAlgorithmsHint: No algorithms selected — check one above to see a digest.
hash.verifyPlaceholder: Paste an expected digest (hex or Base64)
hash.verifyNoMatchSummary: No selected digest matches this value.
hash.pasteOfferText: Move to Verify — this looks like a {algorithms} digest.
hash.overwriteVerifyConfirm: Verify already holds a value — replace it?
hash.overwriteInputConfirm: The input has changed since the move — replace it?

jwt.description: Decode a JWT's header and payload, entirely offline.
jwt.heading: JWT
jwt.caption: Decodes and displays a token's contents. It does not verify signatures.
jwt.helpTrigger: What this tool does and does not do
jwt.helpBody: A JWT has three parts: a header, a payload, and a signature. This tool reads the header and payload and shows them to you. It does not check the signature, so it cannot tell you whether a token is genuine or has been altered.
jwt.notYetValid: This token is not valid yet — it becomes valid {when}.
jwt.unsignedWarning: This token is unsigned or its algorithm is unreadable — anyone can create or alter it.
jwt.oversize: This input is larger than any real token — nothing was decoded.

cron.description: Build a cron expression field by field, or paste one in to read it back. Standard 5-field expressions.
cron.heading: Cron
cron.oversize: Expression too long. This tool handles standard cron expressions up to 1 KB.

bucket.description: Extract text from images, and merge, split, or convert PDFs and images.
bucket.heading: Bucket
bucket.dropHint: Drop a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image anywhere in the window, or paste (⌘V), to extract its text.
bucket.noTextInImage: No text was found in this image.
bucket.noTextInPdf: No text was found in this PDF.

errors.uuid-count-zero: Enter a count of at least 1.
errors.json-trailing-comma: Trailing comma before a closing ] or {'}'} — remove it.
errors.json-trailing-characters: Unexpected content after the JSON value ended — check for an extra closing bracket or stray text.
errors.json-expected-array-separator: Expected , between array items, or ] to close the array.
errors.json-expected-object-separator: Expected , between object entries, or {'}'} to close the object.
errors.json-expected-value: Expected a value here — a string, number, object, array, true, false, or null.
errors.json-invalid-escape: Invalid \ escape sequence in a string.
errors.json-number-out-of-range: Number is too large to represent.
errors.json-control-character: Unescaped control character in a string — escape it as \u00XX.
errors.json-key-must-be-string: Object keys must be strings wrapped in double quotes.
errors.base64-invalid-length: The Base64 input isn't a valid length.
errors.base64-invalid-padding: The Base64 input has invalid padding.
errors.base64-not-utf8: The decoded bytes aren't valid UTF-8 text.
errors.base64-data-uri-malformed: That isn't a valid Base64 data URI — it needs a ';base64,' marker before the payload.
errors.cron-six-field-unsupported: This tool handles standard 5-field cron expressions. Seconds-precision (6-field) expressions aren't supported yet.
